# v0.9.1 validation record

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

This record covers the isolated `moddotplot-interactive-0.9.1-source` copy. The sibling
v0.9.0 source remains available for comparison and rollback. No deployment, upload,
tag, or remote publication is part of this local source-copy release.

## Release acceptance focus

Final integrated validation must establish all of the following:

* package, Rust workspace, generated Wasm package, citation, provenance, and CycloneDX
  metadata consistently identify v0.9.1;
* the deterministic generator reproduces the checked-in
  `Col-CEN_v1.2.Chr1.mdp-overview-v1.gz` byte for byte;
* the 255,582-byte artifact decodes to 16 refined tiles that cover exactly a
  1,000-by-1,000 Chr1 matrix with identity, direction, and support channels;
* corruption, truncation, invalid schema, source/FAI mismatch, incomplete or
  overlapping coverage, and scientific identity/digest mismatch are rejected before
  tile publication;
* the current Wasm scientific configuration matches the artifact's full canonical
  identity exactly, not only its short digest;
* startup verifies the compressed overview against its pinned SHA-256 and requires the
  separately served FAI to exactly match the embedded index;
* launching the bundled example paints its default Chr1 overview without downloading
  the complete FASTA or gating that plot on the annotation;
* cached palette, background, guide, hover, reset, and default-view export operations
  do not request raw FASTA bytes;
* an uncached chromosome, pairwise/grid, zoom/detail, exact, or sequence-track request
  uses bounded same-origin FASTA ranges and reuses a validated resident sequence;
* `200 OK`, malformed or changing `Content-Range`, content encoding, cross-origin
  redirect, overlong/short bodies, and cancellation are handled without full-file
  fallback or stale publication;
* CEN180 retrieval and import run separately after the workspace opens, do not gate the
  precomputed plot, and still produce one logical row mapped to matching chromosomes;
* the complete unit, production-build, documentation, and supported-browser regression
  suites pass on the final integrated source.

## Verification status

Final integrated validation completed on 2026-09-30 with Node 25.9.0 and npm
11.12.1. The final cancellation hardening was additionally exercised with streams
whose `cancel()` promises deliberately reject; a controlled negative run without the
guards produced the expected unhandled rejections, while the guarded build passed.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Rust formatting and linting | Pass: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; Clippy across the workspace, all targets, and all features with warnings denied |
| Rust tests and Wasm target check | Pass: 73 Rust tests (58 core, 4 production-default, 11 Wasm); `wasm32-unknown-unknown` workspace check; focused demand-zoom test |
| Precomputed artifact reproducibility | Pass: generator `--check` reproduced the checked-in 255,582-byte gzip byte for byte |
| TypeScript unit tests | Pass: 31 files, 170 tests passed, 1 intentional scale-test skip; includes a brand-checked worker-fetch regression |
| Production UI/Wasm build | Pass: 30 modules; worker JS 62.81 kB; Wasm 245.26 kB (89.97 kB gzip); main JS 166.16 kB (53.88 kB gzip) |
| Supported-browser suite | Pass: 98 tests passed and 4 intentional export skips across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit in the clean full run |
| v0.9.1 feature browser matrix | Pass in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit using the real bundled artifact, FAI, lazy FASTA ranges, and deferred GFF3 |
| Manual local preview and network trace | Vite's real `Content-Encoding: gzip` response passed focused startup tests in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit; startup/no-FASTA and later `206 Content-Range` behavior were verified through Playwright route assertions |
| Rust workspace and JSON release metadata | Pass: workspace crates, Cargo lockfile, npm packages, citation, provenance, and CycloneDX SBOM identify v0.9.1 |
| Documentation contract | Pass: 78 documentation files checked |

The full browser matrix was also repeated after the final build while the host was
under substantial unrelated CPU load. The bundled v0.9.1 case again passed in all
three engines; several compute-heavy legacy cases exceeded their fixed wall-clock
timeouts under that contention and passed in the clean run above. The final changed
cancellation paths were covered separately by deterministic unit regressions, and an
independent source audit found no release-blocking defect.

## Manual browser checklist

1. Start v0.9.1 on port 4181 with the browser network log empty and cache disabled.
2. Launch the bundled Arabidopsis example. Confirm the precomputed artifact completes
   first and the initial plot is Chr1 self at the default 1,000-cell resolution.
3. Confirm no raw FASTA transfer precedes that plot and CEN180 is not in the startup
   fetch set or on the plot's critical path. Confirm its later job adds one logical row.
4. Change only palette, background, cursor-guide style, and reset state. Confirm these
   operations issue no raw FASTA request and preserve numeric hover values.
5. Select a different chromosome, then exercise Pairwise, Grid, zoom, exact mode, and a
   sequence-derived feature track. Confirm requests use bounded same-origin byte ranges
   and previously loaded records are reused.
6. Test a host that does not honor `Range`. Confirm the application reports the problem
   without consuming the full FASTA response.
7. Corrupt one artifact header, tile payload, and configuration identity in controlled
   fixtures and confirm each is rejected before any tile is published.
